claim_boundary: This comparison describes transcript-derived coverage and same-video co-occurrence for the 18 shared curriculum jobs. A video is not an independently verified speaker/event, co-occurrence is not recurrence across independent events, and these counts do not establish effectiveness, intent, delivery meaning or audience outcomes.
limitations: Speaker and event identity are not independently verified here.
Same-video co-occurrence is not evidence that jobs are causally related.
The fixed atlas excludes one restricted source under its source policy.
Canonical job labels remain provisional and may be wrong or mixed.
Unclassified and media/publisher records are excluded from the 18-job comparison rather than forced into a curriculum job.
